## Variables

### HoldButton

```ts
const HoldButton: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object &
    Omit<ButtonProps, "children" | "onClick"> &
    RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
>;
```

For an action nothing can undo: press and hold (pointer, Space or Enter) while a
fill rises; let go early and it drops back; hold to the top and the action runs.
Under reduced motion the fill rises in three steps.
